COMPANY OVERVIEW

About Aqua Ceramics LLP

Pioneering modern sanitaryware design with vitreous china technology, ergonomics, and durable engineering.

OUR PROMISE

Designed for Comfort, Built for Life

AQUA CERAMICS LLP is dedicated to transforming residential and commercial bathroom spaces through premium ceramic sanitaryware products. Our commitment centers on delivering superior aesthetic appeal, optimal water efficiency, and uncompromised structural reliability.

We offer an extensive range of sanitary solutions engineered for high durability, featuring ultra-smooth nano-glaze treatments, stain resistance, and modern acoustic noise reduction.

Core Business & Product Categories

Aqua Ceramics LLP specializes in three primary sanitaryware categories:

1. Western Toilets / EWC

Wall-hung rimless closets, one-piece siphon water closets, and coupled floor-mounted EWCs.

2. Wash Basins

Designer table-top basins, full pedestal basins, oval vessels, and compact wall-hung basins.

3. Other Sanitaryware

Concealed dual-flush cisterns, ceramic sensor urinals, corner hand-wash basins, and bidets.
